pls.text: Darigaaz learns from Tevesh Szat about the primevals and sets out to save the others, and he resurrects Rith, Dromar and Treva and learns he is the red Primeval.
He declares that sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy immortal hunger ends here, and the four sacrifice themselves in a tar-pit, awakening Crosis.
Karn talks sense into Darigaaz, who plunges into an active volcano to stop the Primevals' complete power, and he dies defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled gods.

mh3.text: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.
